Content:
# Shenzhen's First Open Source Silicon Meetup

@everyone, join @Tim 'mithro' Ansell, @stuart, @Stephan Bökelmann and Biwei Xie on **Wednesday 11 November 2026** at the Chaihuo Maker Space (hosted by @geonzee) for an afternoon filled with talks, silicon demos and a chance to connect with Shenzhen's hardware community! Topics include:
- Open tools, PDKs and shared fabrication routes
- Connecting chip layouts to boards and working hardware
- Research, education and collaboration across the open silicon community

**Learn more and register here**: [outerfab.com/events/szoss/](<https://outerfab.com/events/szoss/>)

Spread the word and let us know if you're coming!!
